title: Challenge 2 Quiz - Foundations of Asset Tokenization

questions.question: What is asset tokenization?
options: The process of creating digital tokens that represent rights connected to a real-world asset

questions.question: Which of the following may be represented by a token?
What is usually the first step in an asset tokenization project?
options: Select the asset to be tokenized
List the tokens on an exchange

questions.question: Why is ownership verification important before tokenization?
options: To confirm that the asset legally belongs to the owner
To reduce the blockchain transaction fee

questions.question: Which professional is commonly responsible for preparing legal agreements?
A fungible token is best described as:
options: A unique token that cannot be replaced
A token that is interchangeable with another identical token

questions.question: Which asset is generally better suited to a non-fungible token (NFT)?
Which of the following is a major benefit of tokenization?
Which statement about liquidity is correct?
options: Every tokenized asset is guaranteed to be easy to sell.
Liquidity depends on market demand, regulations and available buyers.
Liquidity is controlled entirely by blockchain technology.

questions.question: Which statement best describes asset tokenization?
options: It combines blockchain technology with legal and financial structures to represent rights connected to real-world assets.
It removes the need for legal ownership.
It replaces the physical asset completely.
